observations: Photo 0 shows the front cover of a God of War Ragnarök game case for the PlayStation 5.
The case is held by a person in a retail environment with 'PREZIN Gadgets' visible in the background.
The game case is not shown open, so the presence of the actual game disc is unknown.
The background shows other game cases and accessories, suggesting a retail or pawn shop setting.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A photo of the game disc inside the case.

risks.risk: The game may be a digital version rather than a physical disc.
risks.proof: A photo of the digital code or a screenshot of the digital storefront.

risks.risk: The game may be banned from the PlayStation Store.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the game being installed on a PS5 console.

proof_requests: Photo of the game disc inside the case.
Photo of the digital code or installation screen.
Photo of the actual game disc if it is physical.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
